benchmarks.question: Top and bottom 20 client groups by ROE in FY2025 (groups with allocated capital) - label each Top 20 or Bottom 20 and show ROE, median client ROE, revenue, allocated capital and credit cost.
benchmarks.genie_sql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT `Client Group`,
         MEASURE(`ROE %`)                 AS roe,
         MEASURE(`Median Client ROE %`)   AS median_client_roe,
         MEASURE(`Revenue USD`)           AS revenue_usd,
         MEASURE(`Allocated Capital USD`) AS allocated_capital_usd,
         MEASURE(`Credit Cost USD`)       AS credit_cost_usd
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_roe_waterfall
  WHERE `Fiscal Year` = :fiscal_year AND `Client Group` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ALL
  HAVING MEASURE(`Allocated Capital USD`) > CAST(:min_capital_usd AS DOUBLE)
), r AS (
  SELECT g.*, rank() OVER (ORDER BY roe DESC) AS top_rank, rank() OVER (ORDER BY roe ASC) AS bottom_rank FROM g
)
SELECT CASE WHEN top_rank <= 20 THEN 'Top 20' ELSE 'Bottom 20' END AS list, `Client Group` AS client_group, roe,
       median_client_roe, revenue_usd, allocated_capital_usd, credit_cost_usd
FROM r
WHERE top_rank <= 20 OR bottom_rank <= 20
ORDER BY roe DESC

benchmarks.question: What cross-sell would lift the Japanese-corporate single-product lending relationships below the RoRWA hurdle? For each client show its latest-quarter RoRWA, the top cross-sell product from the latest next-best-product scores and its propensity.
benchmarks.genie_sql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT `Client`, MEASURE(`RoRWA %`) AS rorwa_latest_quarter
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_client_profitability
  WHERE `Month` = :month AND `Is Japanese Corporate` AND `Is Single-Product Lending` AND `Below RoRWA Hurdle`
  GROUP BY ALL
), n AS (
  SELECT `Client`, `Product`, MEASURE(`Max Propensity`) AS propensity
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_next_best_product
  WHERE `Month` = :month AND `Is Cross-Sell`
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT b.`Client` AS client, b.rorwa_latest_quarter, max_by(n.`Product`, n.propensity) AS top_cross_sell_product,
       max(n.propensity) AS propensity
FROM b LEFT JOIN n ON n.`Client` = b.`Client`
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY b.rorwa_latest_quarter
benchmarks.expected_sql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT `Client`, MEASURE(`RoRWA %`) AS rorwa_latest_quarter
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_client_profitability
  WHERE `Is Latest Month` AND `Is Japanese Corporate` AND `Is Single-Product Lending` AND `Below RoRWA Hurdle`
  GROUP BY ALL
), n AS (
  SELECT `Client`, `Product`, MEASURE(`Max Propensity`) AS propensity
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_next_best_product
  WHERE `Is Latest Month` AND `Is Cross-Sell`
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT b.`Client` AS client, b.rorwa_latest_quarter, max_by(n.`Product`, n.propensity) AS top_cross_sell_product,
       max(n.propensity) AS propensity
FROM b LEFT JOIN n ON n.`Client` = b.`Client`
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY b.rorwa_latest_quarter

benchmarks.question: Revenue mix by product family for Strategic clients vs Core clients this fiscal year - revenue and each family's share of the tier's revenue.
benchmarks.genie_sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT `Relationship Tier`, `Product Family`, MEASURE(`Total Revenue USD`) AS revenue_usd
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_client_profitability
  WHERE `Fiscal Year` = :fiscal_year AND `Relationship Tier` IN (:tier_a, :tier_b)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Relationship Tier`, `Product Family`, revenue_usd,
       try_divide(revenue_usd,SUM(revenue_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY `Relationship Tier`)) AS revenue_mix_share
FROM r
ORDER BY `Relationship Tier`, revenue_usd DESC
benchmarks.expected_sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT `Relationship Tier`, `Product Family`, MEASURE(`Total Revenue USD`) AS revenue_usd
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_client_profitability
  WHERE `Fiscal Year` = 'FY2026' AND `Relationship Tier` IN ('Strategic', 'Core')
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Relationship Tier`, `Product Family`, revenue_usd,
       revenue_usd / SUM(revenue_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY `Relationship Tier`) AS revenue_mix_share
FROM r
ORDER BY `Relationship Tier`, revenue_usd DESC
